title: XAI-Driven Confidence Estimation for OOD-Resilient Runtime Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning-based resource management (RM) models degrade under out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs at runtime, yet existing approaches in the literature rely on a single global error margin that is overly conservative and fails to distinguish reliablepredictions from catastrophic failures. We propose Lightweight Runtime EXplainability (LEX), the first post-hoc XAI framework for input-specific runtime confidence estimation in ML-based RM. LEX clusters the embeddings of the training input space using a Gaussian Mixture Model and associates per-cluster prediction error bounds to input samples, enabling fine-grained runtime confidence signals without retraining. Evaluated on a state-of-the-art LSTM-based IPS forecasting model on Intel Alder Lake, across 34 benchmark applications, LEX achieves ~94% containment on unseen workloads and produces ~17% tighter per-input confidence bounds than global baselines. translated_title: 面向OOD弹性运行时预测的XAI驱动置信度估计
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的资源管理（RM）模型在运行时面对分布外（OOD）输入时性能会退化，然而文献中现有方法依赖于单一的全局误差裕度，这种方式过于保守，无法区分可靠预测与灾难性故障。我们提出了轻量级运行时可解释性（LEX），这是首个用于基于机器学习的资源管理中输入特定运行时置信度估计的事后XAI框架。LEX使用高斯混合模型对训练输入空间的嵌入进行聚类，并将每个簇的预测误差界限关联到输入样本，从而无需重新训练即可实现细粒度的运行时置信度信号。在Intel Alder Lake平台上，针对最先进的基于LSTM的IPS预测模型、跨34个基准应用程序进行评估，LEX在未见工作负载上实现了约94%的包含率，并且产生的逐输入置信度界限比全局基线紧约17%，而其运行时开销几乎可以忽略。
tldr: 该论文提出LEX——首个用于基于机器学习资源管理的事后XAI运行时置信度估计框架，通过高斯混合模型聚类训练输入嵌入并关联逐簇预测误差界限，无需重训练即可提供细粒度的输入级置信度信号，在OOD工作负载上实现约94%的包含率，并产生比全局基线紧约17%的置信度界限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LEX, the first post-hoc XAI framework for input-specific runtime confidence estimation in ML-based resource management, which clusters training input embeddings via a Gaussian Mixture Model and assigns per-cluster prediction error bounds—without retraining—achieving ~94% containment on unseen workloads and ~17% tighter per-input confidence bounds than global baselines.
